name: Zhejiang Daily Digital Culture Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Daily Digital Culture Group Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an internet digital cultural company in China and internationally. The company engages in internet and related services, focusing on digital culture, digital technology and cultural industry investments, ultural and artistic exchanges, advertising, copyright consulting, internet cultural services, computer and network technology research and development services, data technology services, value-added telecommunications services, exhibition services, non-class training, import and export trade and sales of arts and crafts, cultural and sports goods, office supplies and other related businesses.
